Bravo, you did it!
Sirloin has an amazing meaty flavor!
The limited amount of fat is good news for
your body, too!
Let's both aim for a similar, fat-less body!

Bummer! That was the wrong dish...
You should have eaten the Sirloin!
Yakiniku is when you grill meat on a metal grate!
The Sirloin is the best when it comes to meat with
not much fat!

Bravo, you did it!
Harami is a popular yakiniku dish!
Although kalbi and sirloin are popular,
harami is quite popular as well!

Bummer! That was the wrong dish...
You should have eaten the harami!
Part of the diaphragm, it's considered offal
and is just as popular as other yakiniku meats
like kalbi and sirloin!

Bravo, you did it!
There's no fish more popular in Japan than tuna!
With Tuna Zanmai, you can sample
various types of tuna dishes in one meal!

Bummer! That was the wrong dish...
You should have eaten Tuna Zanmai!
There's no fish more popular in Japan than tuna!

various types of tuna dishes in one meal!

Bravo, you did it!
The Sandwich Set is the go-to light meal!
It's a great way to easily combine different types
of ingredients into one quick food!

Bummer! That was the wrong dish...
You should have eaten the Sandwich Set!
Sandwiches are standard when it comes
to light meals or breakfast!

Bravo, you did it!
A Skewer platter is great for when you feel
like having a bunch of different hot foods!
We should work toward being as colorful as
these skewers!

Bummer! That was the wrong dish...
You should have eaten Grilled Skewers!
There's a variety of hot foods on each skewers!
The Skewer Platter from Yoronotaki has five
flavors in one dish!

Bravo, you did it!
Nothing goes to waste with this dish!
Every part of the fish is used, even its eggs!
Let's be as efficient as this Smelt Fish with Roe!

Bummer! That was the wrong dish...
You should have eaten the Smelt Fish with Roe!
Every part of the fish is used, even its eggs!
You're going to be hooked by the texture!

Bravo, you did it!

The spice from the scallions may tempt you to
drink alcohol, but that's strictly prohibited
during training!

Bummer! That was the wrong dish...
You should have eaten the Kotchori Salad!
You usually associate lettuce with salad,
but Yoronotaki's has lots of scallions!

Bravo, you did it!
Wild Fried Chicken uses boneless chicken thighs!
It's nothing but chicken! Now go turn all that
protein into muscle!

Bummer! That was the wrong dish...
You should have eaten the Wild Fried Chicken!
Plain chicken is a great protein-heavy meal
for training!

Bravo, you did it!
Hamburgers; the staple of fast food!
This one comes with a sunny-side up egg!
I hope you savored every bite!

Bummer! That was the wrong dish...
You should have eaten the Wette Egg Burger!
Hamburgers are the ultimate fast food!
Sunny-side up is the ultimate form of egg!
Put them together for the ultimate meal!

Bravo, you did it!
When you think of Japan's national food,
it has to be curry or ramen!
And when it comes to the national beef dish,
you bet it's beef curry!

Bummer! That was the wrong dish...
You should have eaten Original Beef Curry!
Both curry and ramen are typical Japanese fare,
but the beef curry is the one that uses beef!

Bummer! That was the wrong dish...
You should have eaten the Veggie-filled Soup!
Ringer Hut has a lot of veggie dishes, but the

Twice-cooked Pork in Japan!

was filling and delicious, right!?

Bummer! That was the wrong dish...
You should have eaten the Twice-cooked Pork!
It's the most popular dish that has
both pork and cabbage!

chicken breast!
